chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador began by his Advent
chapter_note: This chapter is almost entirely a compact, numbered cosmological sequence describing ten system-events initiated by the Third Ambassador’s advent (ships, wheels, separation of Night/Day, fall of Sin/abortions, transmigrations). Apart from a brief formulaic opener, there is no exhortation, institutional application, or NT overlay; several items are lacunose.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic compilation frame: “Once again the enlightener speaks …”, presenting the teaching as a reported discourse.

paragraphs.core_text: The first: The Great Builder came forth to build the new aeon.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered cosmological list-item in impersonal expository voice; no citation or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: The ships moved through the heights in the heavens.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmological mechanism (ships/heavens) presented as part of an ordered decade of events.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: The wheels begin to send the life to earth and the upper worlds.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-machine register (“wheels” transmitting “life”) consistent with the old mechanistic substrate style.
Still part of the numbered core sequence; content lost to lacuna.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth is the doors of the ships, that they were opened up [ ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological process-description (doors/ships opened) within the tenfold scheme; lacunose continuation.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth is the doors too [ ... ... that they were opened to receive the waste.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the same cosmic-mechanism list; “waste” fits purification-machine discourse; lacunae present.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh is [the Sin], which he had separated from the rulers by cause of the Third Ambassador; it fell upon the earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal cosmic action (separation from rulers; descent to earth) with personified agent (“Sin” as a cosmological entity), not moral exhortation or contemporary polemic.

paragraphs.core_text: The eighth: Night and day were separated [ ... ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic structuring of time/day-night as an event in the decade; lacunose but clearly cosmological.

paragraphs.core_text: The ninth: The abortions [fell] to the ground.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief but still a cosmological event item (mythic/cosmic fallout) in the enumerated structure.

paragraphs.core_text: The tenth: Transmigrations came about in the zone.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic process (“transmigrations” in the zone) closing the tenfold mechanism-list; impersonal, non-institutional voice.
